name: Sticky & Floating Event Banners for Eventin
author: Marco Petrucci

sections.description:
Sticky & Floating Event Banners for Eventin is a lightweight add-on for the Eventin plugin. It allows you to dynamically generate an interactive banner or a modal window (lightbox) to encourage your users to book upcoming scheduled events.

Main Features:
* Two Templates: Choose between an elegant lightbox window (perfect for the Homepage) or a “sticky” banner at the bottom of the screen.
* Page Assignment: Decide on which pages to display Template 1 or Template 2.
* Full Eventin Integration: Automatically extracts dates, times, and filters from Eventin.
* Optimized Caching: Uses the Transients API to eliminate database load on the frontend.
* Custom Meta Box: Override the button and event text on each individual event page.
* Highly Customizable: Change texts, rotation delay, primary color, and disable the banner on specific URLs.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure you have the Eventin plugin installed and activated.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to Settings -> Eventin Banner to configure the layout and display preferences.
sections.faq:
Why is the banner not showing?

Ensure you have set “Banner active” from the control panel and have at least one published future event (date > today) in Eventin.

Does it work without Eventin?

No. The plugin requires Eventin to be active as it relies on its custom post types (CPTs).
